overview: Discover two exciting Asian destinations in one memorable international holiday.
Experience Bali's tropical landscapes, cultural attractions, waterfalls and iconic rice terraces, followed by a stay in the energetic Vietnamese city of Ho Chi Minh City.

With international flights, comfortable 4-star accommodation, airport transfers and selected Bali sightseeing included, this package is ideal for travellers looking for a short yet exciting multi-country holiday.
